violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The floors (under retail racks) have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Handwashing sink in the bathroom is lacking signage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2024
(Various beverages ) were observed stored on the floor in the (back storage area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the (3 dr reach in cooler(bottom shelf) ) have an accumulation of debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back storage ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 11/21/2024
